cache that supports time-to-live (TTL) expiration for cached entries. It is

  used item is evicted to make space for new items.

  (though it may be lazily cleaned up).

  consistency in multi-threaded environments.

   during background maintenance.

   periodically clean up expired entries, improving read performance by
   avoiding synchronous expiration checks on every operation.

   intervals.

- The cache uses a doubly linked list combined with a hash map (dictionary)
  to achieve O(1) average time complexity for get and put operations.
- The doubly linked list maintains the order of usage (most recent to least
